start: STP_MAIN_DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING=postgresql://preview:preview@127.0.0.1:5432/posts?schema=public npx prisma generate && STP_MAIN_DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING=postgresql://preview:preview@127.0.0.1:5432/posts?schema=public npx prisma db push --skip-generate && PORT=4173 STP_MAIN_DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING=postgresql://preview:preview@127.0.0.1:5432/posts?schema=public npm run preview:start

services.name: PostgreSQL
services.install: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y postgresql
services.start: sudo pg_ctlcluster 16 main start || sudo service postgresql start; sudo -u postgres psql -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='preview'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE USER preview PASSWORD 'preview';"; sudo -u postgres psql -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='posts'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres createdb -O preview posts
